title: 165ft Catamaran
highlights: Heated 4.5-metre outdoor jacuzzi and BBQ counter
Meeting and stage area, bar and karaoke lounge
Two guest suites with double beds and en-suite bathrooms
Twin MTU engines, up to 20 knots
description:
This 165ft power catamaran is a new build, delivered 18 months after the drawings are approved. Her 49.23-metre steel hulls and 12-metre beam carry a composite superstructure with vast teak decks, a heated 4.5-metre jacuzzi, an outdoor dining table for eight and a BBQ counter.

The main deck opens on a lobby lounge, a meeting and stage area with a conference table for twelve, a private dining room for twelve and a full pantry. Upstairs, a bar area, a karaoke lounge and two guest suites with double beds and en-suite bathrooms complete the layout, below a wheelhouse with lounge seating. The crew have their own lounge in the lower hull.

Twin MTU engines of 932 kW give a top speed of 20 knots and a range of 210 nautical miles at 15 knots, with two Kohler generators, a bow thruster, a watermaker and a Raymarine and Furuno navigation package. Images are renderings of the design. Asking $ 15,658,999 FOB Yantian, China.
